features: High-Speed Data Transfer: Experience fast and efficient file transfers with the Ambrane Type-C & Micro USB to USB 3.0 Adapter.
Plug and Play: No need for complex setups or installations - simply connect and start using the adapter instantly.
Charge & Sync: Conveniently charge and synchronize your devices using this versatile adapter.
Stable Output: Enjoy efficient charging power for your devices with a stable output of DC5V 1.5A.
Aluminum Alloy Built: The adapter's durable aluminium alloy construction ensures long-lasting reliability.
480 Mbps Data Transfer: Transfer files at a blazing speed of 480 Mbps for quick and seamless data transfers.
Compatible with Type-C & Micro USB enabled devices: Connect a wide range of devices with Type-C and Micro USB ports for enhanced compatibility.
